name: m14-reference
description: Runnable reference for Module 14 (Government Dev) lesson code: the platform seam and its local implementation. Lesson excerpts are checked against these files (scripts/check-m14-excerpts.mjs).

scripts.validate:collectors: for c in aws google; do docker run --rm -e AWS_REGION=us-gov-west-1 -e GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=demo -v "$PWD/deploy/$c/otel-collector.yaml:/c.yaml:ro" otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.140.0 validate --config=/c.yaml || exit 1; done
